transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining today's legal-review meeting. As you're all aware, we have a DOJ subpoena concerning commission payments made through our international distributors, and we need to submit our initial response and proposed investigation plan next month. The draft currently describes the matter as involving international distributor commissions and proposes preserving relevant records and interviewing implicated personnel. Before I can sign off on any submission, I need each of you to confirm on the record any material factual information relevant to the proposed response terms. Let's go around the table — what can each of you share with us today?
